patch_description: This keeps direct-demand rewards as a useful baseline, but adds a calibrated two-hop relay signal rather than rewarding every possible relay equally. Relay bonuses are moderated relative to direct-link rewards and favor intermediates with lower overall demand pressure, which may be better positioned to carry transit traffic. The terms remain sparse: they use only valid directed two-hop paths, within the allowed cubic bound. A stronger external degree penalty helps keep the low-energy region focused on valid topologies.
